description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the RefreshTokenRepository component of an OAuth module in the OrangeHRM system. It verifies behaviors such as creating, persisting, revoking, and checking revocation status of refresh tokens.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the RefreshTokenRepository's behavior in handling OAuth refresh tokens, including creation, persistence, revocation, and status checks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data fixtures and the RefreshTokenRepository instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Verifies that a new refresh token entity can be created.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Tests persisting a new refresh token and verifies that it is stored correctly with expected properties.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessTokenWithExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to persist a refresh token with a duplicate identifier results in a constraint violation exception.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessToken
methods.description: Tests revoking a refresh token and verifies it's marked as revoked.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessTokenWhichAlreadyRevoked
methods.description: Checks that revoking an already revoked token does not alter its state.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures that revoking a non-existent token does not raise errors and is handled gracefully.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Verifies that the system correctly reports the revocation status of tokens.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevokedForNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Checks revocation status for a token that does not exist, expecting it to be considered revoked.
